manufacturer: Marquis Reagent (H2SO4 + formaldehyde) — Standard forensic spot test
validationStatus: Prototype — colour regions derived from UNODC ST/NAR/42 (2013) Table 1 and Ebejer et al. (2011) Forensic Sci Int. Lab values cross-referenced with DEA Color Chart Series. Not a validated diagnostic instrument. Confirmatory GC-MS required.

referenceCard.description: Software-rendered 8-patch digital reference card displayed on-screen. Patches are rendered by the app in the device native colour space. Use only in DIGITAL CARD mode — the camera reads the on-screen patches directly.
referenceCard.printNotes: No printing required. Open the Digital Reference Card screen on a second phone or tablet and place it next to the sample. The card auto-adjusts brightness for consistent readings.

reactionWindow.observationNotes: Marquis is a single-point spot test. Capture 30-60 seconds after reagent contact when colour has stabilised.

captureInstructions: Add 1-2 drops of Marquis reagent onto a small sample on a white ceramic surface.
Wait 30-60 seconds for the colour to stabilise.
Open the Digital Card screen on a second device and place it beside the sample.
Frame so both the reaction area AND the digital reference card are inside their guides.
Use diffuse indoor light — avoid direct sunlight and camera flash.
Press CHECK FRAME until accepted, then press CAPTURE.
safetyNotes: Marquis reagent contains concentrated sulfuric acid. Wear PPE: gloves, goggles, lab coat.
Dispose per your institution chemical waste procedures.
Purple/violet indicates opiates or MDMA. Orange indicates amphetamines. A positive is presumptive only.
Confirmatory GC-MS or HPLC analysis is mandatory before any legal action.
